description: This source file defines a custom exception class ServiceInvocationException used to represent errors during a remote service invocation, including error codes, messages, and causes.

classes.name: ServiceInvocationException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception that indicates an unexpected outcome of a remote service invocation, encapsulating an HTTP error code and optional message and cause. It includes validation for error codes (must be between 400 and 599) and utility to extract status codes from exceptions.

methods.name: ServiceInvocationException
methods.description: Constructs the exception with an error code, with optional message and cause, validating error code range.

methods.name: getErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the error code associated with the exception.

methods.name: providedOrDefaultMessage
methods.description: Returns the provided message or a default message based on the error code if message is null.

methods.name: extractStatusCode
methods.description: Static method to extract the HTTP status code from a Throwable, returning 500 if not a ServiceInvocationException.
